design_specification.objective: Integrate Benson & Munson (2006) / PETSc SNESVI projected active-set globalization into the HPC cluster execution adapter to extinguish the 61-node (33 boundary node) PDAS chatter and achieve stationary active-set convergence under coupled Abaqus continuation.
core_mechanisms: Projected State Update: trial subproblem phase d_trial is projected via P_[l,u](d) = clip(d, d_ckpt, 1.0), guaranteeing zero overshoot and zero healing by construction.
Dual Residual Tracking: algebraic residual R_d = F - K*d evaluated at projected state, measuring true distance to stationarity.

Safeguarded Cycle-Prevention Projection: boundary nodes with borderline dual residuals (|R_d - tau_res| <= 1e-6) that oscillate between release and predictor healing are stabilized by requiring strict descent into the domain interior before unclamping.
Convergence Criteria: stationary active set (|Delta A| = 0), free-set residual ||R_d||_inf,A <= 1e-6 kN/mm, zero healing, zero overshoot.
